scope: Read-only bounded specification review of the T3 R3 residual writing repair draft against the frozen T3 contract and exact stopped R2 evidence. No implementation, Builder/CLI dispatch, source/test/Git mutation, external, Vault, or network action; no tests run.

r2_residuals: Initial outline publication can install its revision and fail before pending HEAD intent, so exact retry sees a missing unowned HEAD and refuses.

Stored document.kind=[] escapes _load_revision_bundle before its malformed-state guard and causes writing_backup_blockers to raise; ordinary untraced evidence.score=10**400 leaks OverflowError from export_writing_outline.
A self-consistent section child targeting an unwritten section is accepted by history, section export and backup because the stored-state validator returns early for unwritten.

requirements_review.requirement: The first outline publication must establish recognizable ownership before immutable revision publication and recover every recognized interruption by exact retry without recreating deleted or edited HEAD authority.
requirements_review.coverage: The draft fixes the observed ordering defect, requires pre-existing authority checks, retains intent through revision/HEAD/cleanup interruptions, rejects arbitrary missing or deleted HEAD, and requires first-outline and exact-retry regressions.
requirements_review.clarification: Freeze the expected outcome for a fault before the intent payload is complete. Either require the owned marker/partial payload to be repairable by the exact retry, or require the attempt to remain closed without publishing a revision; in both cases test that no unowned revision/HEAD is adopted and that an exact retry reuses one identity.

requirements_review.requirement: All new public writing operations and read-only backup/history paths close malformed JSON-shaped live or stored values without leaking TypeError/OverflowError or mutating state.
requirements_review.coverage: The draft names the malformed enum, huge numeric evidence, nested/missing values, surrogates and filesystem errors; separates invalid live model/context values from conflict diagnostics for stored state; and requires live/history/backup coverage without changing legacy helpers.
requirements_review.clarification: Freeze exact status/shape expectations per boundary, especially LIGHT_CONTEXT_INVALID for the malformed live evidence route and LIGHT_WRITING_PROJECT_CONFLICT plus bounded diagnostics for stored-state/history/backup failures. Add unchanged HEAD/revision/staging/output assertions for malformed live calls, not only the backup no-mutation assertion, and include bool/non-finite/oversized numeric score cases.

requirements_review.requirement: Every successor target is a legal section document and forged unwritten/no-op transitions are rejected consistently while exact retries and normal repeated edits remain valid.
requirements_review.coverage: The draft requires provisional or exact unknown target validation, allows unwritten only at the root or retained non-target positions, and applies replay to history/export/import/retry/backup.
requirements_review.clarification: State explicitly that a published exact target revision is reusable on retry, while a newly forged child whose selected target remains unwritten is rejected; specify whether a newly submitted unknown-to-unknown no-op is rejected or is the deterministic exact retry case. This avoids conflict between 'even if its value equals the parent' and 'reject forged no-op' wording.

limitations: This is a specification completeness review only; it does not accept the R2 implementation, authorize Builder/CLI dispatch, accept source bytes, tests, CI, integration, real data, or human gates.
The R2 residual reports are historical CHANGES_REQUIRED evidence and must remain immutable; they are not retrofitted into the R2 handoff.
The R3 freeze/prompt should bind the exact draft and probe hashes above, preserve cumulative R2 evidence, and require stopped-writing handoff evidence before any implementation acceptance.
